disputed.field: reference_kind label of the degen runs
disputed.reason: The other runs the review listed were relabelled same-lineage. The degen runs were not, because they do not compare pyspi with pyspi. ref_degen recomputes S independently (S_of, numpy only) and derives alpha_max = max|S_offdiag| from the KKT conditions. It passes only if pyspi's output is all zero exactly when alpha_ >= alpha_max. This is the same kind of analytic-condition check as ref_range, which the review accepted as analytic, and it uses pyspi's alpha_ in the same way the accepted kkt/admm runs do. The label has no score effect either way.
